procedure: For each development case (train+val+dev_regression), m in {9,17,33} and protocol P0 (payoff start from t=0, c0=V^T psi0) / P1 (warm start at t0 index, c0=V^T psi_ref(t0) from the Full-n@sub dense reference): plain RRR Galerkin rollout c_{k+1}=expm(h A_mid) c_k, A_mid=A_structured at the step midpoint (one exponential for autonomous cases), reconstruction phi=ell+c V^T on the 24 output rows, density by d2_repo, negative mass = trapezoid in K of max(-f,0). Variants: (1) basis V; (2) basis -V (all column signs flipped, c0 -> -c0); (3) variant (1) with the reconstruction sum evaluated with both factors reversed along the summed (column) axis; (4, extra, more conservative than the plan) alternating column signs; (5, extra) rotated coefficient basis V Q with Q a seeded random orthogonal matrix (same subspace; the exponential and all matvecs act on different floating-point numbers). Paired difference = max over the 24 rows of |negmass_variant - negmass_(1)|; gamma = 10 * max over all cases/m/protocols/variants (floor 1e-16).
